description: Native spatial desktop client for Jcode, a coding agent driven by Claude or ChatGPT subscriptions
notes: The vendor's portable ZIP is unpacked as-is into the Scoop directory; the bundled 'jcode.exe' and 'jcode-harness-api-bridge.exe' are the agent runtime that 'jcode-desktop.exe' launches, so all three stay together.
Settings, sessions and logs live in '%USERPROFILE%\.jcode' (override with the JCODE_HOME environment variable), not in the install directory, so they survive updates and 'scoop uninstall'.

The built-in updater is switched off: '%USERPROFILE%\.jcode\config.toml' is created when missing and patched when it already exists, so '[features] check_updates' ends up false. That is the vendor's documented equivalent of passing --no-update on every launch. Update with 'scoop update jcode-desktop'.
JCode never registers a run-at-login entry: there is no autostart code path in the binaries, so nothing is added to Windows startup.
The bundled 'jcode' CLI is not added to PATH to avoid clashing with a separate Jcode install; run it from the app directory if you need it.
post_install: $settings = '[features]' + "`r`n" + '# Check for and install updates during startup. Disabled so Scoop keeps owning the install.' + "`r`n" + 'check_updates = false' + "`r`n"
